caption: The drawing features a doll standing in profile, facing toward the right. The doll has light skin, blue eyes, rosy cheeks, and blond hair styled in ornate waves or curls, swept back from the face. The doll is dressed in a long black dress that reaches the floor, adorned with a pattern of small pink and purple flowers. The dress features blue-green bows at the neck, waist, and near the hem, and is decorated with black lace trim at the cuffs and along the edges of the skirt and bodice. The doll’s hands are visible and left ungloved. In the upper left-hand corner of the drawing, there is a separate, smaller illustration of a wooden object shaped like a teardrop or shield, marked with "Back" and "Front." The wooden object includes small dials, a piece of text, and a winder or key on the right-hand side; the text is drawn in script but is not fully legible. The background is plain and off-white. The artist’s name, "Beverly Chichester," is written in small lettering near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Walking Doll
